patch_description: Replace the single annealing path with a deterministic portfolio of three continuation schedules distributed across the existing multistarts. Distance-ratio packing objectives have many contact-graph basins, and the sharpness schedule materially affects which basin is reached. The first schedule retains a gentle 6-to-100 quadratic path, the second delays concentration until a slower 6-to-200 path, and the third holds a moderate soft-extrema objective before rapidly focusing on active contacts. The existing exact-ratio selection and final high-sharpness polish compare all candidates without changing the returned format or adding random nondeterminism.
